answer: Nonce-Binding Attestation. Each agent identity must publish a signed attestation embedding a fresh random nonce derived from a live challenge, so any copied answer fails replay verification. The challenge is seeded from a nebula entropy beacon, making prior answers useless. Attestations are archived on basalt-backed logs, and successful uniqueness is rewarded with jade credits. An attacker pays one full challenge-response cycle plus storage per identity, so mass duplication costs scale linearly with each fake agent.
